target: Smooth 60 fps on live vlang.io at 1708x953 and 2x
status: Smooth 60 fps remains open. The verified direct scrollbar batch is on; the fourth frame slot, native grid, color-filter cache, direct filter/opacity groups, backdrop texture cache and gradient-text cache remain opt-in. A later Dawn recorder experiment has separate pending evidence.
scope: Changed native layer publications with changed scroll position after updateLayer, divided by the complete first-to-last input period; not physical scanout.
protocol: Live HTTPS, automatic scripting, empty private profile/cache, no proxy overrides, title readiness plus 10 second settle, 600 delta-8 inputs at nominal 120 Hz reversing every 150. Diagnostic schedules and actual timestamps are retained. OS filesystem/shader caches retained; same C mode and candidate libraries within each pair.

policies.scrollbar_batch: Default since 5acc85b33 after 83.01 to 90.62 and 76.88 to 88.97 fps with improved p95/maxima. A later installed repeat is mixed: 69.94 to 67.90 and 66.21 to 87.08; all attempts retained.
policies.spare_frame: Off: maximum intervals regress in both pairs despite mean gains and three verified slot-3 publications.
policies.native_grid: Off: 75.50 to 84.36 and 83.42 to 72.61 fps. Native mixed-coverage comparisons are within three levels, backend O2/ASan/UBSan checks pass, and live input counters prove grid use.
policies.color_filter_cache: Off: initial one-way diagnostic has no hits; full reversal diagnostic has nine hits and 103 misses. Paired timings 86.50 to 82.57 and 86.60 to 89.02 fps are mixed. Exact bytes/profiles/operations key a bounded 8 MiB cache.
policies.direct_color_filter: Off: no qualifying root filter composites on this live page because the sponsor logos sit inside screen/opacity groups. No acceptance timing collected.
policies.offscreen_groups: Off: actual nested native groups and independent normal/screen arithmetic are exact. Live aggregate counters show 21 group draws in the first diagnostic and 16 in the second; the first eligibility counter mistakenly required an error line and was audited separately. Paired timings 87.07 to 85.55 and 76.07 to 87.00 fps are mixed.
policies.backdrop_texture_cache: Off: exact owned source rows, padding independence, changed source, lifetime and reset tests pass. Six reused input-window restores are verified. Timings 73.67 to 84.21 and 77.66 to 75.94 fps are mixed.
policies.gradient_text_cache: Off: 64 exact cold/warm native cases include real glyphs, gradient colors, masks, backgrounds, fractional phase and both scales. Neither live input diagnostic records a hit; no acceptance timing collected. The initial key contained temporary pixel tokens; the final native key owns canonical image bytes.
policies.digest_assembly: Rejected, absent from source: exact scalar ARM multiply/rotate output has essentially the same microbenchmark timings as the existing compiler output. This diagnostic supplies no scroll credit.

limitations: Native publications are not display scanout. Mean rates above 60 do not establish smooth 60 fps.
All cohorts retain regressions and host contention; no slow trial was retried or omitted.
The top-section sample uses reverse-every=30 and 800 inputs; it is a diagnostic workload, not representative acceptance.

The first native-grid failure was caused by clipping away the MSAA selector; selecting coverage before damage clipping fixes it. A later fixture assertion used an impossible document scroll range and was corrected.
The spare-slot Core Animation fixture initially assumed fallback after three buffers. The corrected four-slot and three-slot fixtures are exact.
The original overlay fixture expected zero rounding; the pre-existing GPU bound of three remains unchanged and outside pixels stay exact.
The gradient test runner initially lacked -fno-rtti for the pinned Skia archive; the corrected runner executes all assertions.
The raw logs preserve each eligibility failure, compile failure, guard/browser exit, and final corrected check. The first offscreen eligibility error is documented in its separate audit.
Measurements use generated native candidate libraries by explicit loader path, with their hashes pinned by the canonical precise tool. No browser bundles or canonical benchmark tools were copied.
